patterns.usage_note: Marks the point something starts or sets out from, in formal written register: signage, station and store announcements, invitations, and business correspondence (正面玄関より, 七時より). から is the ordinary equivalent everywhere else, and outside this announcement register より reads as the comparative. Here it attaches to a noun, whereas comparative より also follows clauses and adjectives.

examples.ruby: お客様[きゃくさま]は正面[しょうめん]玄関[げんかん]よりお入[はい]りください。
examples.english: Customers are asked to enter through the main entrance.

examples.ruby: コンサートは七時[しちじ]よりホールで始[はじ]まります。
examples.english: The concert will begin at seven in the main hall.

examples.ruby: 特急[とっきゅう]は三番[さんばん]ホームより発車[はっしゃ]いたします。
examples.english: The limited express will depart from platform three.
